reason: The catalog page (index.astro) currently shows skill cards as plain links to detail pages — no copy button exists on any card. The CopyButton component exists and is already used on the skill detail page (skill/[name]/index.astro) for chat-agent paste and install commands, but it has never been added to the catalog grid view. The issue asks to put a copy button directly on catalog cards so users can grab the chat-agent paste text without navigating into a skill detail page.

cat site/src/pages/index.astro confirms no CopyButton usage in the catalog page
cat site/src/components/SkillFilters.astro confirms no copy button in the skill card grid
